name: PT Kawasan Industri Jababeka Tbk
summary: PT Kawasan Industri Jababeka Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate business in Indonesia. It operates in five segments: Real Estate, Golf, Service and Maintenance, Power Plant, and Tourism. The Real Estate segment develops and sells industrial estates, and related facilities and services, including residential estates, apartments, office buildings, and shopping centers; and develops and installs water treatment plants, wastewater treatment, telephone, electricity, and sports and recreational facilities to support the industrial estates.
